repoKeys.title: Repository Keys
repoKeys.intro: Each private repository installs with its own non-expiring key that sees only that repository. The keys are embedded in the Pro exe and never written to this computer. Pro's main key is never handed to an install.
repoKeys.help: A key enters the exe only when Pro is built. When a program is opened from Pro, its key is lent to it for that session only; nothing is written to disk, Credential Manager or git settings.

prereq.title: Install these first for {name}?
prereq.body: This program needs the following and they were not found on this computer:
prereq.note: Base installs each one in turn with winget, or with the vendor's official installer after checking its signature when winget is missing. Confirming also accepts the vendors' license terms; Windows may ask for administrator approval.

claude.title: Install Claude Code first?
claude.body: {name} is a Claude Code plugin and Claude Code was not found on this computer. Base installs Claude Code with winget first, then adds the plugin.
